items.title: Charlie Love Interview, 1960-05-10
items.q: I come to find out some of these folks like Ron in the neighborhood. I don't know.

ctx.x: Seven sisters with the seven cats?

Seven sisters. They're no different things and all that. I come to find out some of these folks like Ron in the neighborhood. I don't know. I never did believe in nothing like that, but some people do. A lot of people believe in that.
